faq1Question: Such a check usually costs much less...
faq1Answer: Our verification is much more thorough. In addition to title extracts, lawyers review title documents, check the seller for bankruptcy, criminal involvement, etc. If issues arise, we will advise how to protect yourself from risks.
faq2Question: Do you guarantee that your property verification will completely eliminate the risk of losing the property after purchase?
faq2Answer: We minimize risks: experienced practising lawyers manually review documents and investigate the seller. Other similar services only perform automated checks of documents from public sources.
faq3Question: I'm taking a mortgage. Won't the bank check the property?
faq3Answer: The bank assesses the property's liquidity for the collateral, so it analyses the property against general criteria. That is not enough to identify all possible risks.
faq4Question: I have a realtor, they will check the property and the seller
faq4Answer: Yes, experienced realtors can spot a problematic property or seller. But in complex cases they may also turn to lawyers for deeper analysis or a second opinion.

addPropertyPriceSectionLead: On the left, set the auction dates. On the right, enter the three amounts one step at a time: first the minimum sale price, then (if your listing mode includes it) Buy now, then the starting bid. Each step has a short explanation.
addPropertyPriceStepMinDesc: Below this amount the sale is not final without your agreement — a clear rule for the platform. If anything needs clarifying after the auction, a manager will reach out; you always decide.
addPropertyPriceStepBuyNowDesc: The price for an instant sale during the auction—a buyer can close at this amount without waiting for bidding to end. It is usually not below your minimum sale price.
addPropertyPriceStepStartingDescWithBuyN: The amount at which bidding opens. It cannot exceed 30% of the Buy now price — this keeps the auction entry sensible relative to the instant-purchase price.
addPropertyPriceStepStartingDescAuctionO: The amount at which bidding opens. It is the starting point; the final price can rise as the auction runs.
addPropertyPriceStepLastHint: All amounts set? Check the dates on the left, then tap “Payment and verification”.
addPropertyPriceStartingBidMaxBuyNowPerc: The starting bid cannot exceed 30% of the "Buy now" price.
addPropertyPriceBuyNowStartingBidHint: The starting bid may be at most 30% of the "Buy now" price.

addPropertyPriceHint1Item3: You can set a fixed price or start an auction
addPropertyPriceHint2Text: An auction allows buyers to place bids, which can lead to a higher selling price. You set the starting price, and buyers compete for the property.
addPropertyPriceDescriptionAuction: All properties are listed for auction. You can optionally set a "Buy now" price — the price at which you are willing to sell immediately. If you don't set it, the property will be auction only.
addPropertyPriceDescriptionShares: Specify the total value of the property and how many shares it is divided into. The price per share will be calculated automatically. Auction and test drive are not available for shared ownership.
addPropertyPriceDescriptionDebt: Specify the fixed amount for which you are willing to sell the property with debts. For such listings, auction and test drive are not used — the buyer purchases the property at this price.

sybLandingFaq1Question: How do I join an auction on SellYourBrick?
sybLandingFaq1Answer: Register on the platform, complete verification, and pick a lot in the Auction section. Place a bid within the auction rules — we guide you through every step of the deal.
sybLandingFaq2Question: Which properties are available to buy now?
sybLandingFaq2Answer: The Buy Now section lists lots with a fixed price and no waiting for bidding to end. You can proceed with the purchase on the stated terms right away.
sybLandingFaq3Question: Can I invest in property shares?
sybLandingFaq3Answer: Yes. The Shares section features fractional-ownership projects. You buy a portion of a property and receive returns proportional to your share.
sybLandingFaq4Question: How do I list a property on the platform?
sybLandingFaq4Answer: Click Become a seller in the header or hero, register, and add your property from the dashboard. Our team will help with verification and publishing your lot.

aboutPage_heroLead: SellYourBrick brings together auctions, instant deals, shares, and debt-backed properties. Transparent terms, smart tools, and support at every step.
aboutPage_missionP1: SellYourBrick is a modern online platform for buying, selling, and investing in property worldwide. We connect sellers and buyers on clear terms: transparent auctions, instant buy-now deals, an object map, and personal guidance.
aboutPage_missionP2: Our goal is to make transactions simple, fast, and secure. AI assistant, analytics, documents, and manager chat live in one interface — no endless messages across scattered services.
aboutPage_missionHighlight: Verification, data protection, and support at every step
aboutPage_advantagesSubtitle: Technology and a human approach — in one ecosystem for buyers, sellers, and investors.
aboutPage_advantage1Text: Auction steps, timing, rules, and price dynamics are visible — no hidden terms.
aboutPage_advantage2Text: Map search, favorites, comparison, and buy now — all in one flow.
aboutPage_advantage3Text: Properties in different countries and formats — from apartments to investment shares.
aboutPage_advantage4Text: AI assistant, analytics, yield calculator, and TON payments where it makes sense.
aboutPage_advantage5Text: Managers and VIP guidance — from first interest to deal closure.
aboutPage_advantage6Text: Bid history, documents, notifications, and cabinet — everything at hand.

aboutPage_typeBuyNowText: Fixed price and fast 10% reserve — for those who value speed.
aboutPage_typeSharesText: Invest in property in parts — enter with less capital.

aboutPage_testimonial1Text: Transparent terms and a clear dashboard — I entered a fractional project without endless paperwork. The AI assistant answered document questions quickly.
aboutPage_testimonial2Text: I bid online: timer, bid history, and notifications worked flawlessly. We closed the deal faster than I expected.
aboutPage_testimonial3Text: Listed my property in one evening; a manager helped with verification. The auction attracted serious buyers — the 1% commission felt fair.
aboutPage_faqSubtitle: A quick guide to how the platform works and where to start.
aboutPage_faq1Question: How do I join an auction on SellYourBrick?
aboutPage_faq1Answer: Register, complete verification, and pick a lot in the Auction section. Place bids within the auction rules — we support you through every step of the deal.
aboutPage_faq2Question: How is Buy Now different from an auction?
aboutPage_faq2Answer: Buy Now listings have a fixed price — no waiting for bidding to end. You can reserve the property immediately under the stated terms.
aboutPage_faq3Question: Can I invest in property shares?
aboutPage_faq3Answer: Yes. The Shares section lists fractional-ownership projects. You buy a portion of the asset and earn returns proportional to your share.
aboutPage_faq4Question: How do I list a property on the platform?
aboutPage_faq4Answer: Register as a seller and add your property in the dashboard. A manager will help with verification, publication, and running the auction.
aboutPage_faq5Question: What fees does the platform charge?
aboutPage_faq5Answer: Buyers can choose subscription plans with different features. Sellers pay from €49 per listing plus a 1% commission on successful sales.
